lines.beaver_en: Welcome. Are you looking for something?
lines.learner: 조선 시대 골동품을 좀 보고 싶어요.
lines.en: I'd like to see some Joseon-era antiques.
lines.roman: joseon sidae goldongpumeul jom bogo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: This pottery came from a yangban family.
lines.learner: 그래요? 이 도자기는 유래가 어떻게 돼요?
lines.en: Really? What is the origin of this pottery?
lines.roman: geuraeyo? i dojagineun yuraega eotteoke dwaeyo?

lines.beaver: 조선 중기에 양반 집안에서 쓰던 물건입니다.
lines.beaver_en: A yangban family used it in mid-Joseon.
lines.beaver_roman: joseon junggie yangban jibaneseo sseudeon mulgeonimnida.
lines.en: So it wasn't used in the royal court.

lines.beaver: 네, 하지만 이 거울은 궁에서 나온 것입니다.
lines.beaver_en: Right, but this mirror came from a palace.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, hajiman i geoureun gungeseo naon geosimnida.
lines.en: Really? Who used it in the palace?

lines.beaver: 네, 어린 왕자가 쓰던 거울이라고 합니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, they say a young prince used it.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, eorin wangjaga sseudeon geourirago hamnida.
lines.en: Is there a certificate? I'd like to see it, even if only in a photo.

lines.beaver_en: There is a certificate. Here, take a look.
lines.en: Mirrors like this are very rare, right?

lines.beaver_en: Yes. It's from the early days of Joseon's founding.
lines.en: Where was it after Joseon fell?

lines.beaver_en: It was in Japan, then came back to Korea.
lines.en: So it left in the modern era and returned after liberation.

lines.beaver: 네. 이 칼도 보십시오. 전쟁터에서 쓰던 겁니다.
lines.beaver_en: Yes. Look at this sword too. It was used in battle.
lines.beaver_roman: ne. i kaldo bosipsio. jeonjaengteoeseo sseudeon geomnida.
lines.learner: 백성이 쓰던 칼인가요, 양반이 쓰던 칼인가요?
lines.en: Was it a commoner's sword or a yangban's?
lines.roman: baekseongi sseudeon karingayo, yangbani sseudeon karingayo?

lines.beaver: 양반이 쓰던 칼입니다. 오늘 하나 고르시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: A yangban's. Will you choose one today?
lines.beaver_roman: yangbani sseudeon karimnida. oneul hana goreusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 칼은 비싸네요. 도자기나마 하나 사 갈게요.
lines.en: The sword is pricey. I'll at least buy the pottery.
lines.roman: kareun bissaneyo. dojaginama hana sa galgeyo.
